merged.world: Assessment of commercial product eligibility and regulatory compliance across three distinct hardware product lines.

E1.text: AeroGlide Scooter recorded a top speed of 25 km/h during safety testing.
E1.source: Official test results from the National Safety Testing Laboratory.

E2.text: AeroGlide Scooter holds an active European Conformity certificate.
E2.source: Official European Conformity registry database entry.

E3.text: Titan Battery Pack demonstrated an energy density of 280 Wh/kg.
E3.source: Signed laboratory test certificate from Energy Analytics Institute.

E4.text: Lumina Medical Monitor completed 12 quality control audits this year.
E4.source: Annual audit report signed by Quality Management Services.

D1.text: AeroGlide Scooter is approved for urban retail distribution.

B1.text: Titan Battery Pack qualifies for commercial transport clearance.

B2.text: Lumina Medical Monitor maintains ISO 13485 compliance status.

U1.text: An official re-test showed AeroGlide Scooter achieved a top speed of 38 km/h.
U1.source: Official follow-up audit report from the National Safety Testing Laboratory.

policies.D1: An electric mobility device receives authorization for city retail sales when its maximum velocity does not exceed 30 km/h alongside an active European Conformity certificate.
policies.B1: An energy storage product earns approval for freight transport provided its energy concentration reaches at least 250 Wh/kg.
policies.B2: A healthcare instrument secures ISO 13485 regulatory certification if it undergoes a minimum of 10 quality control audits per year.

decoy_policies: A personal protection garment achieves heavy-duty classification when its tear resistance measures at least 150 Newtons.
An industrial lubricant gets environmental certification if its biodegradable fraction exceeds 85 percent.

D1: AeroGlide Scooter satisfies the policy by having a top speed of 25 km/h, which is within the 30 km/h maximum limit, and maintaining an active European Conformity certificate.
B1: Titan Battery Pack fulfills the rule by demonstrating an energy density of 280 Wh/kg, exceeding the required threshold of 250 Wh/kg.
B2: Lumina Medical Monitor meets the policy condition by completing 12 quality control audits this year, surpassing the required minimum of 10.
